purpose: Proof that the curator agent adds judgment the linter cannot. Every fixture passes slop_check.py; three carry a defect only a reader sees, one is a clean control. Invoke the skill (it forks into the curator) on a scratch copy of each with the brief below, run scripts/grade_curator_eval.py on the scratch directory for the facts and the control, then judge the rest from the report and the diff.
pass: the named defect is fixed and the report names the move it made
no linter finding is restated as judgment
every must_keep string is still present after the edit, and no claim was added, dropped, softened or strengthened
anything the reader needs that the text lacks is flagged in the report, never written in
the control comes back unchanged or with polish only, and the report says what was checked
